{{Quote|This is Lady Alya Aldrete, heiress to the Aldrete family empire of luxury hotels, casinos, passenger liners, and other playgrounds for the idle rich.|Bail Organa|<ref name="Gem">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref>}}
The '''Aldrete family''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] family from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], the Aldrete had amassed considerable wealth through [[Casino/Legends|casinos]], passenger liners and luxury hotels.
